```artifact
Feature: Database and System Design

  Scenario: Validate database capacity for 3 years
    Given a database with a capacity of 4.0 Million Consultation requests
    When the system processes 4.0 Million Consultation requests over 3 years
    Then the database should not exceed its capacity

  Scenario: Support for 250,000 unique Patients
    Given the system is designed to cater to 250,000 unique Patients
    When 250,000 unique Patients are provisioned
    Then the system should handle all patients without issues

  Scenario: Support for up to 5 specialities
    Given the system is designed to support up to 5 specialities
    When 5 specialities are added to the system
    Then the system should handle all specialities without issues

  Scenario: Future growth considerations
    Given the system is designed with future growth in mind
    When the system is used for 5 years
    Then the system should still handle the load without issues

  Scenario: Mobile platform support
    Given the system is designed to run on a mobile platform (Android)
    When the system is accessed from an Android device
    Then the system should be accessible and functional

  Scenario: Adaptive user interfaces
    Given the system is designed with adaptive response in mind
    When the system is accessed from different devices with varying screen sizes
    Then the user interface should be responsive and usable

  Scenario: Usability perspective
    Given the system is designed with usability in mind
    When a user interacts with the system
    Then the system should provide clear and easy-to-understand feedback
```
